[[Herdsman Mehnosi]] owns a herd of [[cow]]s. He hails from the village of [[Ronjok]] and is in need of help to get away from the oppression of the [[Kourna]]n military.

==Locations==
*[[Kourna]]
**[[Marga Coast]] (south of Kournan fort if [[Herds to the Slaughter]] not completed; outside [[Nundu Bay (outpost)|Nundu Bay]] after completion)

==Quests==
:'''Quests involved in:'''
*Kourna
**[[Herds to the Slaughter]]
**[[You Can Run...]]

==Dialogue==
:''"When I was young I wanted to be a great [[Warrior]]. I practiced my sling all day and dreamt of heroic battles at night. Now I'm older and see that protecting the herds is important, too. I'm content. Heroes can be found everywhere, once you learn to recognize them."''
